in_sanskrit.name: निरेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has no lord or master. This name is derived from the Sanskrit roots 'ni' (not) and 'rish' (lord).

in_hindi.name: निरेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: Nirdosh (innocent, guiltless), Nirakar (formless). These meanings are derived from the Hindi pronunciation of 'Niren', which is close to 'Nireesh' in Sanskrit.

in_tamil.name: நிரையன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Niraiyan is a Tamil name which can be derived from the Sanskrit root 'Nir' (not) and 'Eesh' (Lord). This name is used to refer to someone who is free from the control of others and is self-reliant.

in_telugu.name: నిరేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Nireesha is a Telugu name which can be derived from the Sanskrit root 'Nir' (not) and 'Eesh' (Lord). This name is used to refer to someone who is free from the control of others and is self-reliant.

in_marathi.name: Niren
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niren हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niren is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nir' meaning 'inner' and 'rishi' meaning 'seer' or 'sage'. The name refers to one who has control over his mind and is deeply introspective. In Hindu mythology, Niren is also the name of a form of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who helps devotees to overcome their inner struggles.
